digest.component_or_area: automated bug filers and canary alerting
propositions: automated bug filers lack deduplication, file on single flakes, and break silently when create args or gates change
heartbeat-alert filer should file only after 2+ consecutive reds using workflow run-history query, with daily-rate-limited accumulation comments and template validation
binding-drift-alert filer should use dedup + template + abort-if-empty + detected_by without consecutive-red threshold because drift is persistent state unrelated to flakes
conflict-bug filer needs per-conflict stable dedup tag, templated body, abort-if-empty-detail, and detected_by stamping but no auto-close (requires manual adjudication)
bug-creation contract must be documented with exact rebar create args, exit codes, dedup search commands, and REBAR_DETECTED_BY env var for all present and future automated filers
